entries.wants: message shown when a person presses enter on a chat or harness session listed in the terminal interface's sidebar that belongs to another folder than the one this terminal interface was started in, which it cannot open: say it is in the folder {name} and that running `hmz` in that folder opens it
entries.where: one line in the transcript of the terminal interface, one or two short sentences with full stops; keep {name} and `hmz` exactly
entries.text: This is in the folder {name}. Run `hmz` in that folder to open it.

entries.wants: question asked before a folder is forgotten from the sidebar's list of folders: forget the folder {name}?
entries.where: heading of a small confirmation box in the terminal interface, a short question ending in a question mark; keep {name}

entries.wants: line under that question saying what forgetting a folder does: the folder leaves this list and what it was set up with is forgotten; nothing in the directory itself is removed
entries.where: one or two short sentences with full stops under the question of a confirmation box
entries.text: The folder leaves this list and what it was set up with is forgotten. Nothing in the folder itself is removed.

entries.wants: message shown when a person presses enter in the terminal interface's sidebar on a chat that was started in no folder, which the terminal interface cannot open because it carries on only the chats of the folder it was started in: say the chat is in no folder and that the web page opens it
entries.where: one line in the transcript of the terminal interface, one or two short sentences with full stops
entries.text: This chat has no folder. Open it in the browser.
